description:
Ready to master the most challenging part of the Google Cloud Professional Architect exam? This video is a dedicated deep dive into two official case studies: **Helicopter Racing League (HRL)** and **EHR Healthcare**, covering real exam questions **188-210**.

Passing the exam in 2025 requires a deep understanding of how to apply GCP services to complex business problems. This session is designed to give you that exact skill.

In this deep dive, you will master how to architect solutions for:
✅ **Helicopter Racing League (HRL) (Media/Gaming):** Designing secure payment systems, building real-time analytics for massive datasets, and optimizing global content delivery with partners like Fastly.
✅ **EHR Healthcare (Healthcare/Compliance):** Ensuring HIPAA compliance with a Business Associate Agreement (BAA), designing secure GKE networking to reduce attack surfaces, and selecting the right storage solutions for a variety of critical healthcare workloads.

We don't just give you the answers—we teach you the architectural mindset needed to solve any case study scenario thrown at you.
